positiveFindings: Admin-pinned manifest and private WeakMap identities prevent caller-authored verified bits, serialized handles or source-controlled receipt strings from manufacturing authority.
Exact canonical URL, trusted raw/extraction hashes and complete audited unit alignment preserve missing-qualifier/title/altered-text boundaries.
Frozen exact-claim frames and exact relation/material context are separate from truth; counterfactual values remain applicable.
Current/latest/unresolved time fail closed; original proof dates and origin lineage preserved, no extra independent credit or final verdict.
Receipt revocation and explicit installed-manifest retirement prevent old handle/token reuse across manifests.
Bounded local files and artifact totals; no provider/network adapter or production imports in the core.

findings.issue: Token binds risk/conflict Boolean, retained IDs and origin links, but no companion record material. A same-ID companion excerpt can change without invalidating the token when metadata is held fixed. Current contextSHA is not full retained-pool identity.
findings.currentImpact: Unwired capability grants source provenance only and explicitly requires all other gates; it does not currently assign a verdict or suppress conflict.
findings.requiredBeforeRuntimeHook: Bind a deterministic digest of each retained record material and relevant graph/assessment identity, supplied by the trusted runtime; add same-ID companion text/URL/metadata replacement regressions. Recompute ordinary risk/conflict/scope/stance on changed evidence even when provenance receipt remains reusable.

evaluationLimits: Saved22/22 applicability on curated frozen structured frames is a deterministic mechanism check, not evidence that natural-language claim routing works.
Four paired record passages are correlated; no final source-quality model/verdict policy or backend coverage was evaluated.
Issuer identity/competence remains an independently reviewed administrative attestation; integrity verifies installed proof bytes, not an issuer cryptographic signature.
No fresh canonical network reader, current-version authentication or generic raw-English adapter is implemented.
